perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier subfield < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique: [D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The retained-bootstrap result establishes failure of uniform conditional distributional approximation, not undercoverage of Watson et al.'s percentile intervals at any specified level, and the prose appropriately stops short of the latter claim. The uniform coverage and adaptive-loss results apply only to the fixed-dimensional, known-radius, strongly relevant, uniformly conditioned subclass \(\mathcal P_W\), not Watson et al.'s unrestricted \(p=2\) model. The minimax converses match the contact and fixed-interior rates through Gaussian LAN subexperiments, but there is no matching converse for the displayed continuous intermediate-slack elbow. The absence of finite-sample evidence for the proposed multiplier hull and the narrow single-model scope constrain the package's significance at a leading econometrics journal, despite the delivered limit laws, uniform hull, and matched endpoint-regime rates being sufficient for a field-tier contribution. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
